parsed_data.job_overview: Join the team as an AI Engineer Intern to work closely with senior engineers on building and deploying AI/ML applications, with a focus on Generative AI and large language models.
key_deliverables: Prototype implementations of Generative AI features
Tested and benchmarked AI model performance reports
Research summaries on emerging AI technologies
preferred_skills: Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Google ADK)
required_skills: Basic Machine Learning / Deep Learning concepts
responsibilities: Deeply understand project objectives and study data hypotheses under guidance of senior team members
Research and implement algorithms for data science and AI projects
Assist in prototyping features using Generative AI capabilities (LLMs, AI agents, embeddings) and basic NLP concepts
Support testing and benchmarking of AI models using established evaluation frameworks
Stay updated on the latest research, trends, and technologies in data science and AI
